Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics and phosphoproteomics part of this study specifically analyzes a model of carcinogenesis using BJ fibroblasts. The primary biological variable is the genetic state (primary vs immortalized vs tumorigenic vs metastatic) induced by the sequential introduction of hTERT, SV40, and RASG12V. Other perturbations mentioned in the text (Indisulam, spliceosome drugs, TCGA cancer cohorts) were used for validation or computational benchmarking and were not the primary focus of the MS-analyzed samples described in the 'Proteomics and phosphoproteomics of primary fibroblasts during induced carcinogenesis' section.
